
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/19795791" title="发布于 2026-03-30 15:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">龙芯2k0300 - 走马观碑组MPU6050驱动移植</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>在《<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/19731118" target="_blank">龙芯<code>2k0300</code> - 走马观碑组第<code>21</code>届智能汽车竞赛软硬件设计</a>》中我们介绍到我们的开发板使用了<code>MPU6050 </code>陀螺仪，<code>MPU6050</code>是一个六轴姿态传感器，内部集成了三轴加速度计和三轴陀螺仪：</p>
<ul>
<li>加速度计：检测<code>X</code>、<code>Y</code>、<code>Z</code>三个轴上的加速度（比如前进、后退、倾斜）；</li>
<li>陀螺仪：检测绕<code>X</code>、<code>Y</code>、<code>Z</code>轴的旋转速度（比如左转、右转、翻滚）；</li>
</ul>
<img src="https://gitee.com/zyly2033/blog-pic/raw/master/20260318144245411.png?v=1774852411999" alt="img" style="zoom: 67%">
<p><code>MPU6050</code>陀螺仪采用<code>I2C</code>通信方式：</p>
<img src="https://gitee.com/zyly2033/blog-pic/raw/master/20260326112336536.png?v=1774506573989" alt="img" style="zoom: 80%">
<img src="https://gitee.com/zyly2033/blog-pic/raw/master/20260326144222378.png" style="zoom: 80%">
<p><code>MPU6050</code>陀螺仪采用<code>I2C</code>通信方式，与龙芯<code>2K0300</code>开发板的连接关系需严格对应，确保<code>I2C</code>通信与<code>GPIO</code>控制正常，连接表如下：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">屏幕引脚</th>
<th style="text-align: left">功能</th>
<th style="text-align: left">连接的龙芯GPIO</th>
<th style="text-align: left">说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><strong>VCC</strong></td>
<td style="text-align: left">为MPU6050提供工作电压</td>
<td style="text-align: left">3.3V</td>
<td style="text-align: left">接3.3V</td>
</tr>

<td style="text-align: left"><strong>GND</strong></td>

<td style="text-align: left">必须可靠接地，否则可能出现显示异常</td>
</tr>

<h3 id="一mpu6050设备驱动">一、<code>MPU6050</code>设备驱动</h3>
<p><code>MPU6050</code>由于采用了<code>I2C</code>通讯协议，所以涉及到了<code>I2C</code>设备驱动。如果对<code>I2C</code>驱动源码移植感兴趣，可参考：</p>
<ul>
<li>《<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/17094178.html" target="_blank">通信协议-<code>I2C</code></a>》；</li>
<li>《<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/17131339.html" target="_blank"><code>linux</code>驱动移植-<code>I2C</code>总线设备驱动</a>》；</li>
<li>《<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/17133091.html" target="_blank"><code>linux</code>驱动移植-<code>I2C</code>适配器驱动移植</a>》；</li>
<li>《<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/17146122.html" target="_blank"><code>linux</code>驱动移植-<code>I2C</code>驱动移植（<code>OLED SSD1306</code>）</a>》。</li>
</ul>
<p>龙邱科技提供了<code>MPU6050</code>设备驱动实现，位于：<a href="https://gitee.com/lq-tech/Loongson_2k300_301_Library/tree/master/Loongson_2K300_301_LIB/driver/i2c_mpu6050_driver" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><code> i2c_mpu6050_driver</code></a>，只不过这个是基于<code>linux 4.19</code>的，如果移植这个改动的相对较多。</p>
<h4 id="11-内核配置">1.1 内核配置</h4>
<p>实际上我们下载的内核<code>linux 6.12</code>已经内置了<code>MPU6050</code>的驱动，其使用了<code>IIO</code>框架，这里我们就直接使用内核驱动即可，无需从零开发驱动，需开启内核<code>I2C</code>及<code>IIO</code>相关配置，并添加<code>MPU6050</code>驱动代码。</p>
<p>进入内核配置界面：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12$ source ../set_env.sh &amp;&amp; make menuconfig
</code></pre>
<p>依次进入以下菜单：</p>
<pre><code class="language-makefile">Device Drivers  → 
    I2C support   → 
        I2C Hardware Bus support → 
            &lt;*&gt; Loongson fast speed I2C adapter    # 龙芯 2K0300 I2C控制器驱动
        &lt;*&gt;  I2C device interface    
     [*]  Industrial I/O support  → 
		    Inertial measurement units  → 
		    	&lt;*&gt; Invensense MPU6050 devices (I2C) 
</code></pre>
<p>默认会生成配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">CONFIG_I2C_LSFS=y  # 这个已经配置，不用追加
CONFIG_I2C_CHARDEV=y
CONFIG_IIO=y       # 这个已经配置，不用追加
CONFIG_INV_MPU6050_IIO=y
CONFIG_INV_MPU6050_I2C=y
</code></pre>
<p>我们直接修改<code>arch/loongarch/configs/loongson_2k300_defconfig</code>文件，加入这几个配置。</p>
<h4 id="12-mpu6050驱动">1.2 <code>MPU6050</code>驱动</h4>
<p>驱动源码位于<code>drivers/iio/imu/inv_mpu6050/</code>目录下，基于内核<code>IIO</code>框架开发，无需修改内核核心代码，只需编译进内核即可；</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12$ ll drivers/iio/imu/inv_mpu6050/
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang  4620  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_acpi.c
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang  5522  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_aux.c
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang   479  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_aux.h
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang 62807  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_core.c
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang  6467  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_i2c.c
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang 16370  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_iio.h
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang  8654  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_magn.c
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang   931  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_magn.h
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang  3830  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_ring.c
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang  3883  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_spi.c
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang  8786  3月 19 19:48 inv_mpu_trigger.c
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang  1042  3月 19 19:48 Kconfig
-rw-rw-r-- 1 zhengyang zhengyang   417  3月 19 19:48 Makefile
</code></pre>
<p>我们重点关注<code>inv_mpu_i2c.c</code>和<code>inv_mpu_core.c</code>。</p>
<h5 id="121-inv_mpu_i2cc">1.2.1 <code>inv_mpu_i2c.c</code></h5>
<p><code>drivers/iio/imu/inv_mpu6050/inv_mpu_i2c.c</code>源码如下：</p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看详情</summary>
<pre><code class="language-c">// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
/*
* Copyright (C) 2012 Invensense, Inc.
*/

#include &lt;linux/delay.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/err.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/i2c.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/iio/iio.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/mod_devicetable.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/module.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/property.h&gt;

#include "inv_mpu_iio.h"

static const struct regmap_config inv_mpu_regmap_config = {
	.reg_bits = 8,
	.val_bits = 8,
};

static int inv_mpu6050_select_bypass(struct i2c_mux_core *muxc, u32 chan_id)
{
	return 0;
}

static bool inv_mpu_i2c_aux_bus(struct device *dev)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(dev_get_drvdata(dev));

	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_ICM20608:
	case INV_ICM20608D:
	case INV_ICM20609:
	case INV_ICM20689:
	case INV_ICM20600:
	case INV_ICM20602:
	case INV_IAM20680:
		/* no i2c auxiliary bus on the chip */
		return false;
	case INV_MPU9150:
	case INV_MPU9250:
	case INV_MPU9255:
		if (st-&gt;magn_disabled)
			return true;
		else
			return false;
	default:
		return true;
	}
}

static int inv_mpu_i2c_aux_setup(struct iio_dev *indio_dev)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	struct device *dev = indio_dev-&gt;dev.parent;
	struct fwnode_handle *mux_node;
	int ret;

	/*
	 * MPU9xxx magnetometer support requires to disable i2c auxiliary bus.
	 * To ensure backward compatibility with existing setups, do not disable
	 * i2c auxiliary bus if it used.
	 * Check for i2c-gate node in devicetree and set magnetometer disabled.
	 * Only MPU6500 is supported by ACPI, no need to check.
	 */
	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_MPU9150:
	case INV_MPU9250:
	case INV_MPU9255:
		mux_node = device_get_named_child_node(dev, "i2c-gate");
		if (mux_node != NULL) {
			st-&gt;magn_disabled = true;
			dev_warn(dev, "disable internal use of magnetometer\n");
		}
		fwnode_handle_put(mux_node);
		break;
	default:
		break;
	}

	/* enable i2c bypass when using i2c auxiliary bus */
	if (inv_mpu_i2c_aux_bus(dev)) {
		ret = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;int_pin_cfg,
				   st-&gt;irq_mask | INV_MPU6050_BIT_BYPASS_EN);
		if (ret)
			return ret;
	}

	return 0;
}

/**
 *  inv_mpu_probe() - probe function.
 *  @client:          i2c client.
 *
 *  Returns 0 on success, a negative error code otherwise.
 */
static int inv_mpu_probe(struct i2c_client *client)
{
	const struct i2c_device_id *id = i2c_client_get_device_id(client);
	const void *match;
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st;
	int result;
	enum inv_devices chip_type;
	struct regmap *regmap;
	const char *name;

	if (!i2c_check_functionality(client-&gt;adapter,
				     I2C_FUNC_SMBUS_I2C_BLOCK))
		return -EOPNOTSUPP;

	match = device_get_match_data(&amp;client-&gt;dev);
	if (match) {
		chip_type = (uintptr_t)match;
		name = client-&gt;name;
	} else if (id) {
		chip_type = (enum inv_devices)
			id-&gt;driver_data;
		name = id-&gt;name;
	} else {
		return -ENOSYS;
	}

	regmap = devm_regmap_init_i2c(client, &amp;inv_mpu_regmap_config);
	if (IS_ERR(regmap)) {
		dev_err(&amp;client-&gt;dev, "Failed to register i2c regmap: %pe\n",
			regmap);
		return PTR_ERR(regmap);
	}

	result = inv_mpu_core_probe(regmap, client-&gt;irq, name,
				    inv_mpu_i2c_aux_setup, chip_type);
	if (result &lt; 0)
		return result;

	st = iio_priv(dev_get_drvdata(&amp;client-&gt;dev));
	if (inv_mpu_i2c_aux_bus(&amp;client-&gt;dev)) {
		/* declare i2c auxiliary bus */
		st-&gt;muxc = i2c_mux_alloc(client-&gt;adapter, &amp;client-&gt;dev,
					 1, 0, I2C_MUX_LOCKED | I2C_MUX_GATE,
					 inv_mpu6050_select_bypass, NULL);
		if (!st-&gt;muxc)
			return -ENOMEM;
		st-&gt;muxc-&gt;priv = dev_get_drvdata(&amp;client-&gt;dev);
		result = i2c_mux_add_adapter(st-&gt;muxc, 0, 0);
		if (result)
			return result;
		result = inv_mpu_acpi_create_mux_client(client);
		if (result)
			goto out_del_mux;
	}

	return 0;

out_del_mux:
	i2c_mux_del_adapters(st-&gt;muxc);
	return result;
}

static void inv_mpu_remove(struct i2c_client *client)
{
	struct iio_dev *indio_dev = i2c_get_clientdata(client);
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);

	if (st-&gt;muxc) {
		inv_mpu_acpi_delete_mux_client(client);
		i2c_mux_del_adapters(st-&gt;muxc);
	}
}

/*
 * device id table is used to identify what device can be
 * supported by this driver
 */
static const struct i2c_device_id inv_mpu_id[] = {
	{"mpu6050", INV_MPU6050},
	{"mpu6500", INV_MPU6500},
	{"mpu6515", INV_MPU6515},
	{"mpu6880", INV_MPU6880},
	{"mpu9150", INV_MPU9150},
	{"mpu9250", INV_MPU9250},
	{"mpu9255", INV_MPU9255},
	{"icm20608", INV_ICM20608},
	{"icm20608d", INV_ICM20608D},
	{"icm20609", INV_ICM20609},
	{"icm20689", INV_ICM20689},
	{"icm20600", INV_ICM20600},
	{"icm20602", INV_ICM20602},
	{"icm20690", INV_ICM20690},
	{"iam20680", INV_IAM20680},
	{}
};

MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(i2c, inv_mpu_id);

static const struct of_device_id inv_of_match[] = {
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu6050",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU6050
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu6500",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU6500
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu6515",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU6515
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu6880",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU6880
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu9150",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU9150
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu9250",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU9250
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu9255",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU9255
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,icm20608",
		.data = (void *)INV_ICM20608
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,icm20608d",
		.data = (void *)INV_ICM20608D
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,icm20609",
		.data = (void *)INV_ICM20609
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,icm20689",
		.data = (void *)INV_ICM20689
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,icm20600",
		.data = (void *)INV_ICM20600
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,icm20602",
		.data = (void *)INV_ICM20602
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,icm20690",
		.data = (void *)INV_ICM20690
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,iam20680",
		.data = (void *)INV_IAM20680
	},
	{ }
};
MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(of, inv_of_match);

static const struct acpi_device_id inv_acpi_match[] = {
	{"INVN6500", INV_MPU6500},
	{ },
};
MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(acpi, inv_acpi_match);

static struct i2c_driver inv_mpu_driver = {
	.probe		=	inv_mpu_probe,
	.remove		=	inv_mpu_remove,
	.id_table	=	inv_mpu_id,
	.driver = {
		.of_match_table = inv_of_match,
		.acpi_match_table = inv_acpi_match,
		.name	=	"inv-mpu6050-i2c",
		.pm     =       pm_ptr(&amp;inv_mpu_pmops),
	},
};

module_i2c_driver(inv_mpu_driver);

MODULE_AUTHOR("Invensense Corporation");
MODULE_DESCRIPTION("Invensense device MPU6050 driver");
MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_IMPORT_NS(IIO_MPU6050);
</code></pre>
</details>
<h5 id="122--inv_mpu_corec">1.2.2  <code>inv_mpu_core.c</code></h5>
<p><code>drivers/iio/imu/inv_mpu6050/inv_mpu_core.c</code>源码如下：</p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看详情</summary>
<pre><code class="language-c">// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
/*
* Copyright (C) 2012 Invensense, Inc.
*/

#include &lt;linux/module.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/slab.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/i2c.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/err.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/delay.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/sysfs.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/jiffies.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/irq.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/interrupt.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/acpi.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/platform_device.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/regulator/consumer.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/math64.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/minmax.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/pm.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/pm_runtime.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/property.h&gt;

#include &lt;linux/iio/common/inv_sensors_timestamp.h&gt;
#include &lt;linux/iio/iio.h&gt;

#include "inv_mpu_iio.h"
#include "inv_mpu_magn.h"

/*
 * this is the gyro scale translated from dynamic range plus/minus
 * {250, 500, 1000, 2000} to rad/s
 */
static const int gyro_scale_6050[] = {133090, 266181, 532362, 1064724};

/*
 * this is the accel scale translated from dynamic range plus/minus
 * {2, 4, 8, 16} to m/s^2
 */
static const int accel_scale[] = {598, 1196, 2392, 4785};

static const struct inv_mpu6050_reg_map reg_set_icm20602 = {
	.sample_rate_div	= INV_MPU6050_REG_SAMPLE_RATE_DIV,
	.lpf                    = INV_MPU6050_REG_CONFIG,
	.accel_lpf              = INV_MPU6500_REG_ACCEL_CONFIG_2,
	.user_ctrl              = INV_MPU6050_REG_USER_CTRL,
	.fifo_en                = INV_MPU6050_REG_FIFO_EN,
	.gyro_config            = INV_MPU6050_REG_GYRO_CONFIG,
	.accl_config            = INV_MPU6050_REG_ACCEL_CONFIG,
	.fifo_count_h           = INV_MPU6050_REG_FIFO_COUNT_H,
	.fifo_r_w               = INV_MPU6050_REG_FIFO_R_W,
	.raw_gyro               = INV_MPU6050_REG_RAW_GYRO,
	.raw_accl               = INV_MPU6050_REG_RAW_ACCEL,
	.temperature            = INV_MPU6050_REG_TEMPERATURE,
	.int_enable             = INV_MPU6050_REG_INT_ENABLE,
	.int_status             = INV_MPU6050_REG_INT_STATUS,
	.pwr_mgmt_1             = INV_MPU6050_REG_PWR_MGMT_1,
	.pwr_mgmt_2             = INV_MPU6050_REG_PWR_MGMT_2,
	.int_pin_cfg            = INV_MPU6050_REG_INT_PIN_CFG,
	.accl_offset            = INV_MPU6500_REG_ACCEL_OFFSET,
	.gyro_offset            = INV_MPU6050_REG_GYRO_OFFSET,
	.i2c_if                 = INV_ICM20602_REG_I2C_IF,
};

static int inv_mpu6050_pwr_mgmt_1_write(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, bool sleep,
					bool cycle, int clock, int temp_dis)
{
	u8 val;

	if (clock &lt; 0)
		clock = st-&gt;chip_config.clk;
	if (temp_dis &lt; 0)
		temp_dis = !st-&gt;chip_config.temp_en;

	val = clock &amp; INV_MPU6050_BIT_CLK_MASK;
	if (temp_dis)
		val |= INV_MPU6050_BIT_TEMP_DIS;
	if (sleep)
		val |= INV_MPU6050_BIT_SLEEP;
	if (cycle)
		val |= INV_MPU6050_BIT_CYCLE;

	dev_dbg(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map), "pwr_mgmt_1: 0x%x\n", val);
	return regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;pwr_mgmt_1, val);
}

static int inv_mpu6050_clock_switch(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st,
				    unsigned int clock)
{
	int ret;

	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_MPU6050:
	case INV_MPU6000:
	case INV_MPU9150:
		/* old chips: switch clock manually */
		ret = inv_mpu6050_pwr_mgmt_1_write(st, false, false, clock, -1);
		if (ret)
			return ret;
		st-&gt;chip_config.clk = clock;
		break;
	default:
		/* automatic clock switching, nothing to do */
		break;
	}

	return 0;
}

int inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, bool en,
			      unsigned int mask)
{
	unsigned int sleep, val;
	u8 pwr_mgmt2, user_ctrl;
	int ret;

	/* delete useless requests */
	if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL &amp;&amp; en == st-&gt;chip_config.accl_en)
		mask &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL;
	if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO &amp;&amp; en == st-&gt;chip_config.gyro_en)
		mask &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO;
	if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_TEMP &amp;&amp; en == st-&gt;chip_config.temp_en)
		mask &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_TEMP;
	if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_MAGN &amp;&amp; en == st-&gt;chip_config.magn_en)
		mask &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_MAGN;
	if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_WOM &amp;&amp; en == st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en)
		mask &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_WOM;

	/* force accel on if WoM is on and not going off */
	if (!en &amp;&amp; (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL) &amp;&amp; st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en &amp;&amp;
			!(mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_WOM))
		mask &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL;

	if (mask == 0)
		return 0;

	/* turn on/off temperature sensor */
	if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_TEMP) {
		ret = inv_mpu6050_pwr_mgmt_1_write(st, false, false, -1, !en);
		if (ret)
			return ret;
		st-&gt;chip_config.temp_en = en;
	}

	/* update user_crtl for driving magnetometer */
	if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_MAGN) {
		user_ctrl = st-&gt;chip_config.user_ctrl;
		if (en)
			user_ctrl |= INV_MPU6050_BIT_I2C_MST_EN;
		else
			user_ctrl &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_BIT_I2C_MST_EN;
		ret = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;user_ctrl, user_ctrl);
		if (ret)
			return ret;
		st-&gt;chip_config.user_ctrl = user_ctrl;
		st-&gt;chip_config.magn_en = en;
	}

	/* manage accel &amp; gyro engines */
	if (mask &amp; (INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL | INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO)) {
		/* compute power management 2 current value */
		pwr_mgmt2 = 0;
		if (!st-&gt;chip_config.accl_en)
			pwr_mgmt2 |= INV_MPU6050_BIT_PWR_ACCL_STBY;
		if (!st-&gt;chip_config.gyro_en)
			pwr_mgmt2 |= INV_MPU6050_BIT_PWR_GYRO_STBY;

		/* update to new requested value */
		if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL) {
			if (en)
				pwr_mgmt2 &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_BIT_PWR_ACCL_STBY;
			else
				pwr_mgmt2 |= INV_MPU6050_BIT_PWR_ACCL_STBY;
		}
		if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO) {
			if (en)
				pwr_mgmt2 &amp;= ~INV_MPU6050_BIT_PWR_GYRO_STBY;
			else
				pwr_mgmt2 |= INV_MPU6050_BIT_PWR_GYRO_STBY;
		}

		/* switch clock to internal when turning gyro off */
		if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO &amp;&amp; !en) {
			ret = inv_mpu6050_clock_switch(st, INV_CLK_INTERNAL);
			if (ret)
				return ret;
		}

		/* update sensors engine */
		dev_dbg(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map), "pwr_mgmt_2: 0x%x\n",
			pwr_mgmt2);
		ret = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;pwr_mgmt_2, pwr_mgmt2);
		if (ret)
			return ret;
		if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL)
			st-&gt;chip_config.accl_en = en;
		if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO)
			st-&gt;chip_config.gyro_en = en;

		/* compute required time to have sensors stabilized */
		sleep = 0;
		if (en) {
			if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL) {
				if (sleep &lt; st-&gt;hw-&gt;startup_time.accel)
					sleep = st-&gt;hw-&gt;startup_time.accel;
			}
			if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO) {
				if (sleep &lt; st-&gt;hw-&gt;startup_time.gyro)
					sleep = st-&gt;hw-&gt;startup_time.gyro;
			}
		} else {
			if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO) {
				if (sleep &lt; INV_MPU6050_GYRO_DOWN_TIME)
					sleep = INV_MPU6050_GYRO_DOWN_TIME;
			}
		}
		if (sleep)
			msleep(sleep);

		/* switch clock to PLL when turning gyro on */
		if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO &amp;&amp; en) {
			ret = inv_mpu6050_clock_switch(st, INV_CLK_PLL);
			if (ret)
				return ret;
		}
	}

	/* enable/disable accel intelligence control */
	if (mask &amp; INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_WOM) {
		val = en ? INV_MPU6500_BIT_ACCEL_INTEL_EN |
			   INV_MPU6500_BIT_ACCEL_INTEL_MODE : 0;
		ret = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, INV_MPU6500_REG_ACCEL_INTEL_CTRL, val);
		if (ret)
			return ret;
		st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en = en;
	}

	return 0;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_set_power_itg(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st,
				     bool power_on)
{
	int result;

	result = inv_mpu6050_pwr_mgmt_1_write(st, !power_on, false, -1, -1);
	if (result)
		return result;

	if (power_on)
		usleep_range(INV_MPU6050_REG_UP_TIME_MIN,
			     INV_MPU6050_REG_UP_TIME_MAX);

	return 0;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_set_gyro_fsr(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st,
				    enum inv_mpu6050_fsr_e val)
{
	unsigned int gyro_shift;
	u8 data;

	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_ICM20690:
		gyro_shift = INV_ICM20690_GYRO_CONFIG_FSR_SHIFT;
		break;
	default:
		gyro_shift = INV_MPU6050_GYRO_CONFIG_FSR_SHIFT;
		break;
	}

	data = val &lt;&lt; gyro_shift;
	return regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;gyro_config, data);
}

static int inv_mpu6050_set_accel_lpf_regs(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st,
					  enum inv_mpu6050_filter_e val)
{
	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_MPU6050:
	case INV_MPU6000:
	case INV_MPU9150:
		/* old chips, nothing to do */
		return 0;
	case INV_ICM20689:
	case INV_ICM20690:
		/* set FIFO size to maximum value */
		val |= INV_ICM20689_BITS_FIFO_SIZE_MAX;
		break;
	default:
		break;
	}

	return regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;accel_lpf, val);
}

/*
 *  inv_mpu6050_set_lpf_regs() - set low pass filter registers, chip dependent
 *
 *  MPU60xx/MPU9150 use only 1 register for accelerometer + gyroscope
 *  MPU6500 and above have a dedicated register for accelerometer
 */
static int inv_mpu6050_set_lpf_regs(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st,
				    enum inv_mpu6050_filter_e val)
{
	int result;

	result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;lpf, val);
	if (result)
		return result;

	/* set accel lpf */
	return inv_mpu6050_set_accel_lpf_regs(st, val);
}

/*
 *  inv_mpu6050_init_config() - Initialize hardware, disable FIFO.
 *
 *  Initial configuration:
 *  FSR: ± 2000DPS
 *  DLPF: 20Hz
 *  FIFO rate: 50Hz
 *  Clock source: Gyro PLL
 */
static int inv_mpu6050_init_config(struct iio_dev *indio_dev)
{
	int result;
	u8 d;
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	struct inv_sensors_timestamp_chip timestamp;

	result = inv_mpu6050_set_gyro_fsr(st, st-&gt;chip_config.fsr);
	if (result)
		return result;

	result = inv_mpu6050_set_lpf_regs(st, st-&gt;chip_config.lpf);
	if (result)
		return result;

	d = st-&gt;chip_config.divider;
	result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;sample_rate_div, d);
	if (result)
		return result;

	d = (st-&gt;chip_config.accl_fs &lt;&lt; INV_MPU6050_ACCL_CONFIG_FSR_SHIFT);
	result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;accl_config, d);
	if (result)
		return result;

	result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;int_pin_cfg, st-&gt;irq_mask);
	if (result)
		return result;

	/* clock jitter is +/- 2% */
	timestamp.clock_period = NSEC_PER_SEC / INV_MPU6050_INTERNAL_FREQ_HZ;
	timestamp.jitter = 20;
	timestamp.init_period =
			NSEC_PER_SEC / INV_MPU6050_DIVIDER_TO_FIFO_RATE(st-&gt;chip_config.divider);
	inv_sensors_timestamp_init(&amp;st-&gt;timestamp, &amp;timestamp);

	/* magn chip init, noop if not present in the chip */
	result = inv_mpu_magn_probe(st);
	if (result)
		return result;

	return 0;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_sensor_set(struct inv_mpu6050_state  *st, int reg,
				int axis, int val)
{
	int ind;
	__be16 d = cpu_to_be16(val);

	ind = (axis - IIO_MOD_X) * 2;

	return regmap_bulk_write(st-&gt;map, reg + ind, &amp;d, sizeof(d));
}

static int inv_mpu6050_sensor_show(struct inv_mpu6050_state  *st, int reg,
				   int axis, int *val)
{
	int ind, result;
	__be16 d;

	ind = (axis - IIO_MOD_X) * 2;
	result = regmap_bulk_read(st-&gt;map, reg + ind, &amp;d, sizeof(d));
	if (result)
		return result;
	*val = (short)be16_to_cpup(&amp;d);

	return IIO_VAL_INT;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_read_channel_data(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
					 struct iio_chan_spec const *chan,
					 int *val)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	struct device *pdev = regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map);
	unsigned int freq_hz, period_us, min_sleep_us, max_sleep_us;
	int result;
	int ret;

	/* compute sample period */
	freq_hz = INV_MPU6050_DIVIDER_TO_FIFO_RATE(st-&gt;chip_config.divider);
	period_us = 1000000 / freq_hz;

	result = pm_runtime_resume_and_get(pdev);
	if (result)
		return result;

	switch (chan-&gt;type) {
	case IIO_ANGL_VEL:
		if (!st-&gt;chip_config.gyro_en) {
			result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, true,
					INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO);
			if (result)
				goto error_power_off;
			/* need to wait 2 periods to have first valid sample */
			min_sleep_us = 2 * period_us;
			max_sleep_us = 2 * (period_us + period_us / 2);
			usleep_range(min_sleep_us, max_sleep_us);
		}
		ret = inv_mpu6050_sensor_show(st, st-&gt;reg-&gt;raw_gyro,
					      chan-&gt;channel2, val);
		break;
	case IIO_ACCEL:
		if (!st-&gt;chip_config.accl_en) {
			result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, true,
					INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL);
			if (result)
				goto error_power_off;
			/* wait 1 period for first sample availability */
			min_sleep_us = period_us;
			max_sleep_us = period_us + period_us / 2;
			usleep_range(min_sleep_us, max_sleep_us);
		}
		ret = inv_mpu6050_sensor_show(st, st-&gt;reg-&gt;raw_accl,
					      chan-&gt;channel2, val);
		break;
	case IIO_TEMP:
		/* temperature sensor work only with accel and/or gyro */
		if (!st-&gt;chip_config.accl_en &amp;&amp; !st-&gt;chip_config.gyro_en) {
			result = -EBUSY;
			goto error_power_off;
		}
		if (!st-&gt;chip_config.temp_en) {
			result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, true,
					INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_TEMP);
			if (result)
				goto error_power_off;
			/* wait 1 period for first sample availability */
			min_sleep_us = period_us;
			max_sleep_us = period_us + period_us / 2;
			usleep_range(min_sleep_us, max_sleep_us);
		}
		ret = inv_mpu6050_sensor_show(st, st-&gt;reg-&gt;temperature,
					      IIO_MOD_X, val);
		break;
	case IIO_MAGN:
		if (!st-&gt;chip_config.magn_en) {
			result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, true,
					INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_MAGN);
			if (result)
				goto error_power_off;
			/* frequency is limited for magnetometer */
			if (freq_hz &gt; INV_MPU_MAGN_FREQ_HZ_MAX) {
				freq_hz = INV_MPU_MAGN_FREQ_HZ_MAX;
				period_us = 1000000 / freq_hz;
			}
			/* need to wait 2 periods to have first valid sample */
			min_sleep_us = 2 * period_us;
			max_sleep_us = 2 * (period_us + period_us / 2);
			usleep_range(min_sleep_us, max_sleep_us);
		}
		ret = inv_mpu_magn_read(st, chan-&gt;channel2, val);
		break;
	default:
		ret = -EINVAL;
		break;
	}

	pm_runtime_mark_last_busy(pdev);
	pm_runtime_put_autosuspend(pdev);

	return ret;

error_power_off:
	pm_runtime_put_autosuspend(pdev);
	return result;
}

static int
inv_mpu6050_read_raw(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
		     struct iio_chan_spec const *chan,
		     int *val, int *val2, long mask)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state  *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	int ret = 0;

	switch (mask) {
	case IIO_CHAN_INFO_RAW:
		ret = iio_device_claim_direct_mode(indio_dev);
		if (ret)
			return ret;
		mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
		ret = inv_mpu6050_read_channel_data(indio_dev, chan, val);
		mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
		iio_device_release_direct_mode(indio_dev);
		return ret;
	case IIO_CHAN_INFO_SCALE:
		switch (chan-&gt;type) {
		case IIO_ANGL_VEL:
			mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
			*val  = 0;
			*val2 = gyro_scale_6050[st-&gt;chip_config.fsr];
			mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

			return IIO_VAL_INT_PLUS_NANO;
		case IIO_ACCEL:
			mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
			*val = 0;
			*val2 = accel_scale[st-&gt;chip_config.accl_fs];
			mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

			return IIO_VAL_INT_PLUS_MICRO;
		case IIO_TEMP:
			*val = st-&gt;hw-&gt;temp.scale / 1000000;
			*val2 = st-&gt;hw-&gt;temp.scale % 1000000;
			return IIO_VAL_INT_PLUS_MICRO;
		case IIO_MAGN:
			return inv_mpu_magn_get_scale(st, chan, val, val2);
		default:
			return -EINVAL;
		}
	case IIO_CHAN_INFO_OFFSET:
		switch (chan-&gt;type) {
		case IIO_TEMP:
			*val = st-&gt;hw-&gt;temp.offset;
			return IIO_VAL_INT;
		default:
			return -EINVAL;
		}
	case IIO_CHAN_INFO_CALIBBIAS:
		switch (chan-&gt;type) {
		case IIO_ANGL_VEL:
			mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
			ret = inv_mpu6050_sensor_show(st, st-&gt;reg-&gt;gyro_offset,
						chan-&gt;channel2, val);
			mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
			return ret;
		case IIO_ACCEL:
			mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
			ret = inv_mpu6050_sensor_show(st, st-&gt;reg-&gt;accl_offset,
						chan-&gt;channel2, val);
			mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
			return ret;

		default:
			return -EINVAL;
		}
	default:
		return -EINVAL;
	}
}

static int inv_mpu6050_write_gyro_scale(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, int val,
					int val2)
{
	int result, i;

	if (val != 0)
		return -EINVAL;

	for (i = 0; i &lt; ARRAY_SIZE(gyro_scale_6050); ++i) {
		if (gyro_scale_6050[i] == val2) {
			result = inv_mpu6050_set_gyro_fsr(st, i);
			if (result)
				return result;

			st-&gt;chip_config.fsr = i;
			return 0;
		}
	}

	return -EINVAL;
}

static int inv_write_raw_get_fmt(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
				 struct iio_chan_spec const *chan, long mask)
{
	switch (mask) {
	case IIO_CHAN_INFO_SCALE:
		switch (chan-&gt;type) {
		case IIO_ANGL_VEL:
			return IIO_VAL_INT_PLUS_NANO;
		default:
			return IIO_VAL_INT_PLUS_MICRO;
		}
	default:
		return IIO_VAL_INT_PLUS_MICRO;
	}

	return -EINVAL;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_write_accel_scale(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, int val,
					 int val2)
{
	int result, i;
	u8 d;

	if (val != 0)
		return -EINVAL;

	for (i = 0; i &lt; ARRAY_SIZE(accel_scale); ++i) {
		if (accel_scale[i] == val2) {
			d = (i &lt;&lt; INV_MPU6050_ACCL_CONFIG_FSR_SHIFT);
			result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;accl_config, d);
			if (result)
				return result;

			st-&gt;chip_config.accl_fs = i;
			return 0;
		}
	}

	return -EINVAL;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_write_raw(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
				 struct iio_chan_spec const *chan,
				 int val, int val2, long mask)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state  *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	struct device *pdev = regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map);
	int result;

	/*
	 * we should only update scale when the chip is disabled, i.e.
	 * not running
	 */
	result = iio_device_claim_direct_mode(indio_dev);
	if (result)
		return result;

	mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
	result = pm_runtime_resume_and_get(pdev);
	if (result)
		goto error_write_raw_unlock;

	switch (mask) {
	case IIO_CHAN_INFO_SCALE:
		switch (chan-&gt;type) {
		case IIO_ANGL_VEL:
			result = inv_mpu6050_write_gyro_scale(st, val, val2);
			break;
		case IIO_ACCEL:
			result = inv_mpu6050_write_accel_scale(st, val, val2);
			break;
		default:
			result = -EINVAL;
			break;
		}
		break;
	case IIO_CHAN_INFO_CALIBBIAS:
		switch (chan-&gt;type) {
		case IIO_ANGL_VEL:
			result = inv_mpu6050_sensor_set(st,
							st-&gt;reg-&gt;gyro_offset,
							chan-&gt;channel2, val);
			break;
		case IIO_ACCEL:
			result = inv_mpu6050_sensor_set(st,
							st-&gt;reg-&gt;accl_offset,
							chan-&gt;channel2, val);
			break;
		default:
			result = -EINVAL;
			break;
		}
		break;
	default:
		result = -EINVAL;
		break;
	}

	pm_runtime_mark_last_busy(pdev);
	pm_runtime_put_autosuspend(pdev);
error_write_raw_unlock:
	mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
	iio_device_release_direct_mode(indio_dev);

	return result;
}

static u64 inv_mpu6050_convert_wom_to_roc(unsigned int threshold, unsigned int freq_div)
{
	/* 4mg per LSB converted in m/s² in micro (1000000) */
	const unsigned int convert = 4U * 9807U;
	u64 value;

	value = threshold * convert;

	/* compute the differential by multiplying by the frequency */
	return div_u64(value * INV_MPU6050_INTERNAL_FREQ_HZ, freq_div);
}

static unsigned int inv_mpu6050_convert_roc_to_wom(u64 roc, unsigned int freq_div)
{
	/* 4mg per LSB converted in m/s² in micro (1000000) */
	const unsigned int convert = 4U * 9807U;
	u64 value;

	/* return 0 only if roc is 0 */
	if (roc == 0)
		return 0;

	value = div_u64(roc * freq_div, convert * INV_MPU6050_INTERNAL_FREQ_HZ);

	/* limit value to 8 bits and prevent 0 */
	return min(255, max(1, value));
}

static int inv_mpu6050_set_wom_int(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, bool on)
{
	unsigned int reg_val, val;

	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_MPU6050:
	case INV_MPU6500:
	case INV_MPU6515:
	case INV_MPU6880:
	case INV_MPU6000:
	case INV_MPU9150:
	case INV_MPU9250:
	case INV_MPU9255:
		reg_val = INV_MPU6500_BIT_WOM_INT_EN;
		break;
	default:
		reg_val = INV_ICM20608_BIT_WOM_INT_EN;
		break;
	}

	val = on ? reg_val : 0;

	return regmap_update_bits(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;int_enable, reg_val, val);
}

static int inv_mpu6050_set_wom_threshold(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, u64 value,
					 unsigned int freq_div)
{
	unsigned int threshold;
	int result;

	/* convert roc to wom threshold and convert back to handle clipping */
	threshold = inv_mpu6050_convert_roc_to_wom(value, freq_div);
	value = inv_mpu6050_convert_wom_to_roc(threshold, freq_div);

	dev_dbg(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map), "wom_threshold: 0x%x\n", threshold);

	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_ICM20609:
	case INV_ICM20689:
	case INV_ICM20600:
	case INV_ICM20602:
	case INV_ICM20690:
		st-&gt;data[0] = threshold;
		st-&gt;data[1] = threshold;
		st-&gt;data[2] = threshold;
		result = regmap_bulk_write(st-&gt;map, INV_ICM20609_REG_ACCEL_WOM_X_THR,
					   st-&gt;data, 3);
		break;
	default:
		result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, INV_MPU6500_REG_WOM_THRESHOLD, threshold);
		break;
	}
	if (result)
		return result;

	st-&gt;chip_config.roc_threshold = value;

	return 0;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_set_lp_odr(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, unsigned int freq_div,
				  unsigned int *lp_div)
{
	static const unsigned int freq_dividers[] = {2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256};
	static const unsigned int reg_values[] = {
		INV_MPU6050_LPOSC_500HZ, INV_MPU6050_LPOSC_250HZ,
		INV_MPU6050_LPOSC_125HZ, INV_MPU6050_LPOSC_62HZ,
		INV_MPU6050_LPOSC_31HZ, INV_MPU6050_LPOSC_16HZ,
		INV_MPU6050_LPOSC_8HZ, INV_MPU6050_LPOSC_4HZ,
	};
	unsigned int val, i;

	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_ICM20609:
	case INV_ICM20689:
	case INV_ICM20600:
	case INV_ICM20602:
	case INV_ICM20690:
		/* nothing to do */
		*lp_div = INV_MPU6050_FREQ_DIVIDER(st);
		return 0;
	default:
		break;
	}

	/* found the nearest superior frequency divider */
	i = ARRAY_SIZE(reg_values) - 1;
	val = reg_values[i];
	*lp_div = freq_dividers[i];
	for (i = 0; i &lt; ARRAY_SIZE(freq_dividers); ++i) {
		if (freq_div &lt;= freq_dividers[i]) {
			val = reg_values[i];
			*lp_div = freq_dividers[i];
			break;
		}
	}

	dev_dbg(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map), "lp_odr: 0x%x\n", val);
	return regmap_write(st-&gt;map, INV_MPU6500_REG_LP_ODR, val);
}

static int inv_mpu6050_set_wom_lp(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, bool on)
{
	unsigned int lp_div;
	int result;

	if (on) {
		/* set low power ODR */
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_lp_odr(st, INV_MPU6050_FREQ_DIVIDER(st), &amp;lp_div);
		if (result)
			return result;
		/* disable accel low pass filter */
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_accel_lpf_regs(st, INV_MPU6050_FILTER_NOLPF);
		if (result)
			return result;
		/* update wom threshold with new low-power frequency divider */
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_threshold(st, st-&gt;chip_config.roc_threshold, lp_div);
		if (result)
			return result;
		/* set cycle mode */
		result = inv_mpu6050_pwr_mgmt_1_write(st, false, true, -1, -1);
	} else {
		/* disable cycle mode */
		result = inv_mpu6050_pwr_mgmt_1_write(st, false, false, -1, -1);
		if (result)
			return result;
		/* restore wom threshold */
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_threshold(st, st-&gt;chip_config.roc_threshold,
						       INV_MPU6050_FREQ_DIVIDER(st));
		if (result)
			return result;
		/* restore accel low pass filter */
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_accel_lpf_regs(st, st-&gt;chip_config.lpf);
	}

	return result;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_enable_wom(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, bool en)
{
	struct device *pdev = regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map);
	unsigned int mask;
	int result;

	if (en) {
		result = pm_runtime_resume_and_get(pdev);
		if (result)
			return result;

		mask = INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL | INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_WOM;
		result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, true, mask);
		if (result)
			goto error_suspend;

		result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_int(st, true);
		if (result)
			goto error_suspend;
	} else {
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_int(st, false);
		if (result)
			dev_err(pdev, "error %d disabling WoM interrupt bit", result);

		/* disable only WoM and let accel be disabled by autosuspend */
		result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, false, INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_WOM);
		if (result) {
			dev_err(pdev, "error %d disabling WoM force off", result);
			/* force WoM off */
			st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en = false;
		}

		pm_runtime_mark_last_busy(pdev);
		pm_runtime_put_autosuspend(pdev);
	}

	return result;

error_suspend:
	pm_runtime_mark_last_busy(pdev);
	pm_runtime_put_autosuspend(pdev);
	return result;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_read_event_config(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
					 const struct iio_chan_spec *chan,
					 enum iio_event_type type,
					 enum iio_event_direction dir)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);

	/* support only WoM (accel roc rising) event */
	if (chan-&gt;type != IIO_ACCEL || type != IIO_EV_TYPE_ROC ||
	    dir != IIO_EV_DIR_RISING)
		return -EINVAL;

	guard(mutex)(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	return st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en ? 1 : 0;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_write_event_config(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
					  const struct iio_chan_spec *chan,
					  enum iio_event_type type,
					  enum iio_event_direction dir,
					  int state)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	int enable;

	/* support only WoM (accel roc rising) event */
	if (chan-&gt;type != IIO_ACCEL || type != IIO_EV_TYPE_ROC ||
	    dir != IIO_EV_DIR_RISING)
		return -EINVAL;

	enable = !!state;

	guard(mutex)(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	if (st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en == enable)
		return 0;

	return inv_mpu6050_enable_wom(st, enable);
}

static int inv_mpu6050_read_event_value(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
					const struct iio_chan_spec *chan,
					enum iio_event_type type,
					enum iio_event_direction dir,
					enum iio_event_info info,
					int *val, int *val2)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	u32 rem;

	/* support only WoM (accel roc rising) event value */
	if (chan-&gt;type != IIO_ACCEL || type != IIO_EV_TYPE_ROC ||
	    dir != IIO_EV_DIR_RISING || info != IIO_EV_INFO_VALUE)
		return -EINVAL;

	guard(mutex)(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	/* return value in micro */
	*val = div_u64_rem(st-&gt;chip_config.roc_threshold, 1000000U, &amp;rem);
	*val2 = rem;

	return IIO_VAL_INT_PLUS_MICRO;
}

static int inv_mpu6050_write_event_value(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
					 const struct iio_chan_spec *chan,
					 enum iio_event_type type,
					 enum iio_event_direction dir,
					 enum iio_event_info info,
					 int val, int val2)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	struct device *pdev = regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map);
	u64 value;
	int result;

	/* support only WoM (accel roc rising) event value */
	if (chan-&gt;type != IIO_ACCEL || type != IIO_EV_TYPE_ROC ||
	    dir != IIO_EV_DIR_RISING || info != IIO_EV_INFO_VALUE)
		return -EINVAL;

	if (val &lt; 0 || val2 &lt; 0)
		return -EINVAL;

	guard(mutex)(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	result = pm_runtime_resume_and_get(pdev);
	if (result)
		return result;

	value = (u64)val * 1000000ULL + (u64)val2;
	result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_threshold(st, value, INV_MPU6050_FREQ_DIVIDER(st));

	pm_runtime_mark_last_busy(pdev);
	pm_runtime_put_autosuspend(pdev);

	return result;
}

/*
 *  inv_mpu6050_set_lpf() - set low pass filer based on fifo rate.
 *
 *                  Based on the Nyquist principle, the bandwidth of the low
 *                  pass filter must not exceed the signal sampling rate divided
 *                  by 2, or there would be aliasing.
 *                  This function basically search for the correct low pass
 *                  parameters based on the fifo rate, e.g, sampling frequency.
 *
 *  lpf is set automatically when setting sampling rate to avoid any aliases.
 */
static int inv_mpu6050_set_lpf(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st, int rate)
{
	static const int hz[] = {400, 200, 90, 40, 20, 10};
	static const int d[] = {
		INV_MPU6050_FILTER_200HZ, INV_MPU6050_FILTER_100HZ,
		INV_MPU6050_FILTER_45HZ, INV_MPU6050_FILTER_20HZ,
		INV_MPU6050_FILTER_10HZ, INV_MPU6050_FILTER_5HZ
	};
	int i, result;
	u8 data;

	data = INV_MPU6050_FILTER_5HZ;
	for (i = 0; i &lt; ARRAY_SIZE(hz); ++i) {
		if (rate &gt;= hz[i]) {
			data = d[i];
			break;
		}
	}
	result = inv_mpu6050_set_lpf_regs(st, data);
	if (result)
		return result;
	st-&gt;chip_config.lpf = data;

	return 0;
}

/*
 * inv_mpu6050_fifo_rate_store() - Set fifo rate.
 */
static ssize_t
inv_mpu6050_fifo_rate_store(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr,
			    const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	int fifo_rate;
	u32 fifo_period;
	bool fifo_on;
	u8 d;
	int result;
	struct iio_dev *indio_dev = dev_to_iio_dev(dev);
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	struct device *pdev = regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map);

	if (kstrtoint(buf, 10, &amp;fifo_rate))
		return -EINVAL;
	if (fifo_rate &lt; INV_MPU6050_MIN_FIFO_RATE ||
	    fifo_rate &gt; INV_MPU6050_MAX_FIFO_RATE)
		return -EINVAL;

	/* compute the chip sample rate divider */
	d = INV_MPU6050_FIFO_RATE_TO_DIVIDER(fifo_rate);
	/* compute back the fifo rate to handle truncation cases */
	fifo_rate = INV_MPU6050_DIVIDER_TO_FIFO_RATE(d);
	fifo_period = NSEC_PER_SEC / fifo_rate;

	mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
	if (d == st-&gt;chip_config.divider) {
		result = 0;
		goto fifo_rate_fail_unlock;
	}

	fifo_on = st-&gt;chip_config.accl_fifo_enable ||
		  st-&gt;chip_config.gyro_fifo_enable ||
		  st-&gt;chip_config.magn_fifo_enable;
	result = inv_sensors_timestamp_update_odr(&amp;st-&gt;timestamp, fifo_period, fifo_on);
	if (result)
		goto fifo_rate_fail_unlock;

	result = pm_runtime_resume_and_get(pdev);
	if (result)
		goto fifo_rate_fail_unlock;

	result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;sample_rate_div, d);
	if (result)
		goto fifo_rate_fail_power_off;
	st-&gt;chip_config.divider = d;

	result = inv_mpu6050_set_lpf(st, fifo_rate);
	if (result)
		goto fifo_rate_fail_power_off;

	/* update rate for magn, noop if not present in chip */
	result = inv_mpu_magn_set_rate(st, fifo_rate);
	if (result)
		goto fifo_rate_fail_power_off;

	/* update wom threshold since roc is dependent on sampling frequency */
	result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_threshold(st, st-&gt;chip_config.roc_threshold,
					       INV_MPU6050_FREQ_DIVIDER(st));
	if (result)
		goto fifo_rate_fail_power_off;

	pm_runtime_mark_last_busy(pdev);
fifo_rate_fail_power_off:
	pm_runtime_put_autosuspend(pdev);
fifo_rate_fail_unlock:
	mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
	if (result)
		return result;

	return count;
}

/*
 * inv_fifo_rate_show() - Get the current sampling rate.
 */
static ssize_t
inv_fifo_rate_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr,
		   char *buf)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(dev_to_iio_dev(dev));
	unsigned fifo_rate;

	mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
	fifo_rate = INV_MPU6050_DIVIDER_TO_FIFO_RATE(st-&gt;chip_config.divider);
	mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	return scnprintf(buf, PAGE_SIZE, "%u\n", fifo_rate);
}

/*
 * inv_attr_show() - calling this function will show current
 *                    parameters.
 *
 * Deprecated in favor of IIO mounting matrix API.
 *
 * See inv_get_mount_matrix()
 */
static ssize_t inv_attr_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr,
			     char *buf)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(dev_to_iio_dev(dev));
	struct iio_dev_attr *this_attr = to_iio_dev_attr(attr);
	s8 *m;

	switch (this_attr-&gt;address) {
	/*
	 * In MPU6050, the two matrix are the same because gyro and accel
	 * are integrated in one chip
	 */
	case ATTR_GYRO_MATRIX:
	case ATTR_ACCL_MATRIX:
		m = st-&gt;plat_data.orientation;

		return scnprintf(buf, PAGE_SIZE,
			"%d, %d, %d; %d, %d, %d; %d, %d, %d\n",
			m[0], m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5], m[6], m[7], m[8]);
	default:
		return -EINVAL;
	}
}

/**
 * inv_mpu6050_validate_trigger() - validate_trigger callback for invensense
 *                                  MPU6050 device.
 * @indio_dev: The IIO device
 * @trig: The new trigger
 *
 * Returns: 0 if the 'trig' matches the trigger registered by the MPU6050
 * device, -EINVAL otherwise.
 */
static int inv_mpu6050_validate_trigger(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
					struct iio_trigger *trig)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);

	if (st-&gt;trig != trig)
		return -EINVAL;

	return 0;
}

static const struct iio_mount_matrix *
inv_get_mount_matrix(const struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
		     const struct iio_chan_spec *chan)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *data = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	const struct iio_mount_matrix *matrix;

	if (chan-&gt;type == IIO_MAGN)
		matrix = &amp;data-&gt;magn_orient;
	else
		matrix = &amp;data-&gt;orientation;

	return matrix;
}

static const struct iio_chan_spec_ext_info inv_ext_info[] = {
	IIO_MOUNT_MATRIX(IIO_SHARED_BY_TYPE, inv_get_mount_matrix),
	{ }
};

	{
		.type = IIO_EV_TYPE_ROC,
		.dir = IIO_EV_DIR_RISING,
		.mask_separate = BIT(IIO_EV_INFO_ENABLE) |
				 BIT(IIO_EV_INFO_VALUE),
	},
};

	{                                                             \
		.type = _type,                                        \
		.modified = 1,                                        \
		.channel2 = _channel2,                                \
		.info_mask_shared_by_type = BIT(IIO_CHAN_INFO_SCALE), \
		.info_mask_separate = BIT(IIO_CHAN_INFO_RAW) |	      \
				      BIT(IIO_CHAN_INFO_CALIBBIAS),   \
		.scan_index = _index,                                 \
		.scan_type = {                                        \
				.sign = 's',                          \
				.realbits = 16,                       \
				.storagebits = 16,                    \
				.shift = 0,                           \
				.endianness = IIO_BE,                 \
			     },                                       \

	}

				| BIT(IIO_CHAN_INFO_OFFSET)	\
				| BIT(IIO_CHAN_INFO_SCALE),	\
		.scan_index = _index,				\
		.scan_type = {					\
			.sign = 's',				\
			.realbits = 16,				\
			.storagebits = 16,			\
			.shift = 0,				\
			.endianness = IIO_BE,			\
		},						\
	}

{									\
	.type = _type,							\
	.modified = 1,							\
	.channel2 = _channel2,						\
	.event_spec = _events,						\
	.num_event_specs = _events_nb,					\
	.scan_index = -1,						\
}

		| INV_MPU6050_SCAN_MASK_TEMP,

/*
 * The user can choose any frequency between INV_MPU6050_MIN_FIFO_RATE and
 * INV_MPU6050_MAX_FIFO_RATE, but only these frequencies are matched by the
 * low-pass filter. Specifically, each of these sampling rates are about twice
 * the bandwidth of a corresponding low-pass filter, which should eliminate
 * aliasing following the Nyquist principle. By picking a frequency different
 * from these, the user risks aliasing effects.
 */
static IIO_CONST_ATTR_SAMP_FREQ_AVAIL("10 20 50 100 200 500");
static IIO_CONST_ATTR(in_anglvel_scale_available,
					  "0.000133090 0.000266181 0.000532362 0.001064724");
static IIO_CONST_ATTR(in_accel_scale_available,
					  "0.000598 0.001196 0.002392 0.004785");
static IIO_DEV_ATTR_SAMP_FREQ(S_IRUGO | S_IWUSR, inv_fifo_rate_show,
	inv_mpu6050_fifo_rate_store);

/* Deprecated: kept for userspace backward compatibility. */
static IIO_DEVICE_ATTR(in_gyro_matrix, S_IRUGO, inv_attr_show, NULL,
	ATTR_GYRO_MATRIX);
static IIO_DEVICE_ATTR(in_accel_matrix, S_IRUGO, inv_attr_show, NULL,
	ATTR_ACCL_MATRIX);

static struct attribute *inv_attributes[] = {
	&amp;iio_dev_attr_in_gyro_matrix.dev_attr.attr,  /* deprecated */
	&amp;iio_dev_attr_in_accel_matrix.dev_attr.attr, /* deprecated */
	&amp;iio_dev_attr_sampling_frequency.dev_attr.attr,
	&amp;iio_const_attr_sampling_frequency_available.dev_attr.attr,
	&amp;iio_const_attr_in_accel_scale_available.dev_attr.attr,
	&amp;iio_const_attr_in_anglvel_scale_available.dev_attr.attr,
	NULL,
};

static const struct attribute_group inv_attribute_group = {
	.attrs = inv_attributes
};

static int inv_mpu6050_reg_access(struct iio_dev *indio_dev,
				  unsigned int reg,
				  unsigned int writeval,
				  unsigned int *readval)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	int ret;

	mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
	if (readval)
		ret = regmap_read(st-&gt;map, reg, readval);
	else
		ret = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, reg, writeval);
	mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	return ret;
}

static const struct iio_info mpu_info = {
	.read_raw = &amp;inv_mpu6050_read_raw,
	.write_raw = &amp;inv_mpu6050_write_raw,
	.write_raw_get_fmt = &amp;inv_write_raw_get_fmt,
	.attrs = &amp;inv_attribute_group,
	.read_event_config = inv_mpu6050_read_event_config,
	.write_event_config = inv_mpu6050_write_event_config,
	.read_event_value = inv_mpu6050_read_event_value,
	.write_event_value = inv_mpu6050_write_event_value,
	.validate_trigger = inv_mpu6050_validate_trigger,
	.debugfs_reg_access = &amp;inv_mpu6050_reg_access,
};

/*
 *  inv_check_and_setup_chip() - check and setup chip.
 */
static int inv_check_and_setup_chip(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st)
{
	int result;
	unsigned int regval, mask;
	int i;

	st-&gt;hw  = &amp;hw_info[st-&gt;chip_type];
	st-&gt;reg = hw_info[st-&gt;chip_type].reg;
	memcpy(&amp;st-&gt;chip_config, hw_info[st-&gt;chip_type].config,
	       sizeof(st-&gt;chip_config));
	st-&gt;data = devm_kzalloc(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map), st-&gt;hw-&gt;fifo_size, GFP_KERNEL);
	if (st-&gt;data == NULL)
		return -ENOMEM;

	/* check chip self-identification */
	result = regmap_read(st-&gt;map, INV_MPU6050_REG_WHOAMI, &amp;regval);
	if (result)
		return result;
	if (regval != st-&gt;hw-&gt;whoami) {
		/* check whoami against all possible values */
		for (i = 0; i &lt; INV_NUM_PARTS; ++i) {
			if (regval == hw_info[i].whoami) {
				dev_warn(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map),
					"whoami mismatch got 0x%02x (%s) expected 0x%02x (%s)\n",
					regval, hw_info[i].name,
					st-&gt;hw-&gt;whoami, st-&gt;hw-&gt;name);
				break;
			}
		}
		if (i &gt;= INV_NUM_PARTS) {
			dev_err(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map),
				"invalid whoami 0x%02x expected 0x%02x (%s)\n",
				regval, st-&gt;hw-&gt;whoami, st-&gt;hw-&gt;name);
			return -ENODEV;
		}
	}

	/* reset to make sure previous state are not there */
	result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, st-&gt;reg-&gt;pwr_mgmt_1,
			      INV_MPU6050_BIT_H_RESET);
	if (result)
		return result;
	msleep(INV_MPU6050_POWER_UP_TIME);
	switch (st-&gt;chip_type) {
	case INV_MPU6000:
	case INV_MPU6500:
	case INV_MPU6515:
	case INV_MPU6880:
	case INV_MPU9250:
	case INV_MPU9255:
		/* reset signal path (required for spi connection) */
		regval = INV_MPU6050_BIT_TEMP_RST | INV_MPU6050_BIT_ACCEL_RST |
			 INV_MPU6050_BIT_GYRO_RST;
		result = regmap_write(st-&gt;map, INV_MPU6050_REG_SIGNAL_PATH_RESET,
				      regval);
		if (result)
			return result;
		msleep(INV_MPU6050_POWER_UP_TIME);
		break;
	default:
		break;
	}

	/*
	 * Turn power on. After reset, the sleep bit could be on
	 * or off depending on the OTP settings. Turning power on
	 * make it in a definite state as well as making the hardware
	 * state align with the software state
	 */
	result = inv_mpu6050_set_power_itg(st, true);
	if (result)
		return result;
	mask = INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL | INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO |
			INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_TEMP | INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_MAGN;
	result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, false, mask);
	if (result)
		goto error_power_off;

	return 0;

error_power_off:
	inv_mpu6050_set_power_itg(st, false);
	return result;
}

static int inv_mpu_core_enable_regulator_vddio(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st)
{
	int result;

	result = regulator_enable(st-&gt;vddio_supply);
	if (result) {
		dev_err(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map),
			"Failed to enable vddio regulator: %d\n", result);
	} else {
		/* Give the device a little bit of time to start up. */
		usleep_range(3000, 5000);
	}

	return result;
}

static int inv_mpu_core_disable_regulator_vddio(struct inv_mpu6050_state *st)
{
	int result;

	result = regulator_disable(st-&gt;vddio_supply);
	if (result)
		dev_err(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map),
			"Failed to disable vddio regulator: %d\n", result);

	return result;
}

static void inv_mpu_core_disable_regulator_action(void *_data)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = _data;
	int result;

	result = regulator_disable(st-&gt;vdd_supply);
	if (result)
		dev_err(regmap_get_device(st-&gt;map),
			"Failed to disable vdd regulator: %d\n", result);

	inv_mpu_core_disable_regulator_vddio(st);
}

static void inv_mpu_pm_disable(void *data)
{
	struct device *dev = data;

	pm_runtime_disable(dev);
}

int inv_mpu_core_probe(struct regmap *regmap, int irq, const char *name,
		int (*inv_mpu_bus_setup)(struct iio_dev *), int chip_type)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st;
	struct iio_dev *indio_dev;
	struct inv_mpu6050_platform_data *pdata;
	struct device *dev = regmap_get_device(regmap);
	int result;
	struct irq_data *desc;
	int irq_type;

	indio_dev = devm_iio_device_alloc(dev, sizeof(*st));
	if (!indio_dev)
		return -ENOMEM;

	BUILD_BUG_ON(ARRAY_SIZE(hw_info) != INV_NUM_PARTS);
	if (chip_type &lt; 0 || chip_type &gt;= INV_NUM_PARTS) {
		dev_err(dev, "Bad invensense chip_type=%d name=%s\n",
				chip_type, name);
		return -ENODEV;
	}
	st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	mutex_init(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
	st-&gt;chip_type = chip_type;
	st-&gt;irq = irq;
	st-&gt;map = regmap;

	st-&gt;level_shifter = device_property_read_bool(dev,
						      "invensense,level-shifter");
	pdata = dev_get_platdata(dev);
	if (!pdata) {
		result = iio_read_mount_matrix(dev, &amp;st-&gt;orientation);
		if (result) {
			dev_err(dev, "Failed to retrieve mounting matrix %d\n",
				result);
			return result;
		}
	} else {
		st-&gt;plat_data = *pdata;
	}

	if (irq &gt; 0) {
		desc = irq_get_irq_data(irq);
		if (!desc) {
			dev_err(dev, "Could not find IRQ %d\n", irq);
			return -EINVAL;
		}

		irq_type = irqd_get_trigger_type(desc);
		if (!irq_type)
			irq_type = IRQF_TRIGGER_RISING;
	} else {
		/* Doesn't really matter, use the default */
		irq_type = IRQF_TRIGGER_RISING;
	}

	if (irq_type &amp; IRQF_TRIGGER_RISING)	// rising or both-edge
		st-&gt;irq_mask = INV_MPU6050_ACTIVE_HIGH;
	else if (irq_type == IRQF_TRIGGER_FALLING)
		st-&gt;irq_mask = INV_MPU6050_ACTIVE_LOW;
	else if (irq_type == IRQF_TRIGGER_HIGH)
		st-&gt;irq_mask = INV_MPU6050_ACTIVE_HIGH |
			INV_MPU6050_LATCH_INT_EN;
	else if (irq_type == IRQF_TRIGGER_LOW)
		st-&gt;irq_mask = INV_MPU6050_ACTIVE_LOW |
			INV_MPU6050_LATCH_INT_EN;
	else {
		dev_err(dev, "Invalid interrupt type 0x%x specified\n",
			irq_type);
		return -EINVAL;
	}
	device_set_wakeup_capable(dev, true);

	st-&gt;vdd_supply = devm_regulator_get(dev, "vdd");
	if (IS_ERR(st-&gt;vdd_supply))
		return dev_err_probe(dev, PTR_ERR(st-&gt;vdd_supply),
				     "Failed to get vdd regulator\n");

	st-&gt;vddio_supply = devm_regulator_get(dev, "vddio");
	if (IS_ERR(st-&gt;vddio_supply))
		return dev_err_probe(dev, PTR_ERR(st-&gt;vddio_supply),
				     "Failed to get vddio regulator\n");

	result = regulator_enable(st-&gt;vdd_supply);
	if (result) {
		dev_err(dev, "Failed to enable vdd regulator: %d\n", result);
		return result;
	}
	msleep(INV_MPU6050_POWER_UP_TIME);

	result = inv_mpu_core_enable_regulator_vddio(st);
	if (result) {
		regulator_disable(st-&gt;vdd_supply);
		return result;
	}

	result = devm_add_action_or_reset(dev, inv_mpu_core_disable_regulator_action,
				 st);
	if (result) {
		dev_err(dev, "Failed to setup regulator cleanup action %d\n",
			result);
		return result;
	}

	/* fill magnetometer orientation */
	result = inv_mpu_magn_set_orient(st);
	if (result)
		return result;

	/* power is turned on inside check chip type*/
	result = inv_check_and_setup_chip(st);
	if (result)
		return result;

	result = inv_mpu6050_init_config(indio_dev);
	if (result) {
		dev_err(dev, "Could not initialize device.\n");
		goto error_power_off;
	}

	dev_set_drvdata(dev, indio_dev);
	/* name will be NULL when enumerated via ACPI */
	if (name)
		indio_dev-&gt;name = name;
	else
		indio_dev-&gt;name = dev_name(dev);

	/* requires parent device set in indio_dev */
	if (inv_mpu_bus_setup) {
		result = inv_mpu_bus_setup(indio_dev);
		if (result)
			goto error_power_off;
	}

	/* chip init is done, turning on runtime power management */
	result = pm_runtime_set_active(dev);
	if (result)
		goto error_power_off;
	pm_runtime_get_noresume(dev);
	pm_runtime_enable(dev);
	pm_runtime_set_autosuspend_delay(dev, INV_MPU6050_SUSPEND_DELAY_MS);
	pm_runtime_use_autosuspend(dev);
	pm_runtime_put(dev);
	result = devm_add_action_or_reset(dev, inv_mpu_pm_disable, dev);
	if (result)
		return result;

	switch (chip_type) {
	case INV_MPU6000:
	case INV_MPU6050:
		indio_dev-&gt;channels = inv_mpu6050_channels;
		indio_dev-&gt;num_channels = ARRAY_SIZE(inv_mpu6050_channels);
		indio_dev-&gt;available_scan_masks = inv_mpu_scan_masks;
		break;
	case INV_MPU9150:
		indio_dev-&gt;channels = inv_mpu9150_channels;
		indio_dev-&gt;num_channels = ARRAY_SIZE(inv_mpu9150_channels);
		indio_dev-&gt;available_scan_masks = inv_mpu9x50_scan_masks;
		break;
	case INV_MPU9250:
	case INV_MPU9255:
		indio_dev-&gt;channels = inv_mpu9250_channels;
		indio_dev-&gt;num_channels = ARRAY_SIZE(inv_mpu9250_channels);
		indio_dev-&gt;available_scan_masks = inv_mpu9x50_scan_masks;
		break;
	case INV_ICM20600:
	case INV_ICM20602:
		indio_dev-&gt;channels = inv_mpu6500_channels;
		indio_dev-&gt;num_channels = ARRAY_SIZE(inv_mpu6500_channels);
		indio_dev-&gt;available_scan_masks = inv_icm20602_scan_masks;
		break;
	default:
		indio_dev-&gt;channels = inv_mpu6500_channels;
		indio_dev-&gt;num_channels = ARRAY_SIZE(inv_mpu6500_channels);
		indio_dev-&gt;available_scan_masks = inv_mpu_scan_masks;
		break;
	}
	/*
	 * Use magnetometer inside the chip only if there is no i2c
	 * auxiliary device in use. Otherwise Going back to 6-axis only.
	 */
	if (st-&gt;magn_disabled) {
		switch (chip_type) {
		case INV_MPU9150:
			indio_dev-&gt;channels = inv_mpu6050_channels;
			indio_dev-&gt;num_channels = ARRAY_SIZE(inv_mpu6050_channels);
			indio_dev-&gt;available_scan_masks = inv_mpu_scan_masks;
			break;
		default:
			indio_dev-&gt;channels = inv_mpu6500_channels;
			indio_dev-&gt;num_channels = ARRAY_SIZE(inv_mpu6500_channels);
			indio_dev-&gt;available_scan_masks = inv_mpu_scan_masks;
			break;
		}
	}

	indio_dev-&gt;info = &amp;mpu_info;

	if (irq &gt; 0) {
		/*
		 * The driver currently only supports buffered capture with its
		 * own trigger. So no IRQ, no trigger, no buffer
		 */
		result = devm_iio_triggered_buffer_setup(dev, indio_dev,
							 iio_pollfunc_store_time,
							 inv_mpu6050_read_fifo,
							 NULL);
		if (result) {
			dev_err(dev, "configure buffer fail %d\n", result);
			return result;
		}

		result = inv_mpu6050_probe_trigger(indio_dev, irq_type);
		if (result) {
			dev_err(dev, "trigger probe fail %d\n", result);
			return result;
		}
	}

	result = devm_iio_device_register(dev, indio_dev);
	if (result) {
		dev_err(dev, "IIO register fail %d\n", result);
		return result;
	}

	return 0;

error_power_off:
	inv_mpu6050_set_power_itg(st, false);
	return result;
}
EXPORT_SYMBOL_NS_GPL(inv_mpu_core_probe, IIO_MPU6050);

static int inv_mpu_resume(struct device *dev)
{
	struct iio_dev *indio_dev = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	bool wakeup;
	int result;

	guard(mutex)(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	wakeup = device_may_wakeup(dev) &amp;&amp; st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en;

	if (wakeup) {
		enable_irq(st-&gt;irq);
		disable_irq_wake(st-&gt;irq);
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_lp(st, false);
		if (result)
			return result;
	} else {
		result = inv_mpu_core_enable_regulator_vddio(st);
		if (result)
			return result;
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_power_itg(st, true);
		if (result)
			return result;
	}

	pm_runtime_disable(dev);
	pm_runtime_set_active(dev);
	pm_runtime_enable(dev);

	result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, true, st-&gt;suspended_sensors);
	if (result)
		return result;

	if (st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en &amp;&amp; !wakeup) {
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_int(st, true);
		if (result)
			return result;
	}

	if (iio_buffer_enabled(indio_dev))
		result = inv_mpu6050_prepare_fifo(st, true);

	return result;
}

static int inv_mpu_suspend(struct device *dev)
{
	struct iio_dev *indio_dev = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(indio_dev);
	bool wakeup;
	int result;

	guard(mutex)(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	st-&gt;suspended_sensors = 0;
	if (pm_runtime_suspended(dev))
		return 0;

	if (iio_buffer_enabled(indio_dev)) {
		result = inv_mpu6050_prepare_fifo(st, false);
		if (result)
			return result;
	}

	wakeup = device_may_wakeup(dev) &amp;&amp; st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en;

	if (st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en &amp;&amp; !wakeup) {
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_int(st, false);
		if (result)
			return result;
	}

	if (st-&gt;chip_config.accl_en &amp;&amp; !wakeup)
		st-&gt;suspended_sensors |= INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL;
	if (st-&gt;chip_config.gyro_en)
		st-&gt;suspended_sensors |= INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO;
	if (st-&gt;chip_config.temp_en)
		st-&gt;suspended_sensors |= INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_TEMP;
	if (st-&gt;chip_config.magn_en)
		st-&gt;suspended_sensors |= INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_MAGN;
	if (st-&gt;chip_config.wom_en &amp;&amp; !wakeup)
		st-&gt;suspended_sensors |= INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_WOM;
	result = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, false, st-&gt;suspended_sensors);
	if (result)
		return result;

	if (wakeup) {
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_wom_lp(st, true);
		if (result)
			return result;
		enable_irq_wake(st-&gt;irq);
		disable_irq(st-&gt;irq);
	} else {
		result = inv_mpu6050_set_power_itg(st, false);
		if (result)
			return result;
		inv_mpu_core_disable_regulator_vddio(st);
	}

	return 0;
}

static int inv_mpu_runtime_suspend(struct device *dev)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(dev_get_drvdata(dev));
	unsigned int sensors;
	int ret;

	mutex_lock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);

	sensors = INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_ACCL | INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_GYRO |
			INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_TEMP | INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_MAGN |
			INV_MPU6050_SENSOR_WOM;
	ret = inv_mpu6050_switch_engine(st, false, sensors);
	if (ret)
		goto out_unlock;

	ret = inv_mpu6050_set_power_itg(st, false);
	if (ret)
		goto out_unlock;

	inv_mpu_core_disable_regulator_vddio(st);

out_unlock:
	mutex_unlock(&amp;st-&gt;lock);
	return ret;
}

static int inv_mpu_runtime_resume(struct device *dev)
{
	struct inv_mpu6050_state *st = iio_priv(dev_get_drvdata(dev));
	int ret;

	ret = inv_mpu_core_enable_regulator_vddio(st);
	if (ret)
		return ret;

	return inv_mpu6050_set_power_itg(st, true);
}

EXPORT_NS_GPL_DEV_PM_OPS(inv_mpu_pmops, IIO_MPU6050) = {
	SYSTEM_SLEEP_PM_OPS(inv_mpu_suspend, inv_mpu_resume)
	RUNTIME_PM_OPS(inv_mpu_runtime_suspend, inv_mpu_runtime_resume, NULL)
};

MODULE_AUTHOR("Invensense Corporation");
MODULE_DESCRIPTION("Invensense device MPU6050 driver");
MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_IMPORT_NS(IIO_INV_SENSORS_TIMESTAMP);
</code></pre>
</details>
<h4 id="13-新增设备节点">1.3 新增设备节点</h4>
<p>这里我们将<code>MPU6050</code>接到<code>i2c1</code>接口，因此需要适当调整设备树。</p>
<h5 id="131-i2c1">1.3.1 <code>i2c1</code></h5>
<p><code>i2c1</code>节点定义在<code>arch/loongarch/boot/dts/loongson-2k0300.dtsi</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-makefile">i2c1: i2c1@0x16109000 {
        compatible = "loongson,lsfs-i2c";
        reg = &lt;0 0x16109000 0 0x1000&gt;;
        #address-cells = &lt;1&gt;;
        #size-cells = &lt;0&gt;;
        interrupt-parent = &lt;&amp;liointc0&gt;;
        interrupts = &lt;4 IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_HIGH&gt;;
        pinctrl-0 = &lt;&amp;i2c1_pins&gt;;
        pinctrl-names = "default";
        clock-frequency = &lt;200000000&gt;;
        status = "disabled";
};
</code></pre>
<p>其中：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>i2c1:</code>：标签，用于在设备树中其他地方通过<code>&amp;i2c1</code>引用这个节点，方便添加属性或修改状态；</li>
<li><code>i2c1@0x16109000</code>：节点名，格式为 <code>设备名@寄存器基地址</code>。这里<code>i2c1</code>是功能名，<code>0x16109000</code>是该<code>I2C</code>控制器的物理寄存器基地址。</li>
<li><code>compatible</code>：驱动匹配字符串。内核通过该属性寻找能驱动此设备的驱动程序；</li>
<li><code>reg</code>：寄存器地址范围。格式为 <code>&lt;地址高位 地址低位 长度高位 长度低位&gt;</code>，由于龙芯采用<code>64</code>位寻址，这里用两个<code>32</code>位数表示<code>64</code>位地址；</li>
<li><code>#address-cells</code>和<code>#size-cells</code>：定义该节点下子节点（即挂载的<code>I2C</code>从设备）的地址和长度格式。
<ul>
<li><code>#address-cells = &lt;1&gt;</code>：子节点的 <code>reg</code> 属性中，地址部分占用<code>1</code>个<code>32</code>位单元。对于<code>I2C</code>设备，这通常是<code>7</code>位从设备地址；</li>
<li><code>#size-cells = &lt;0&gt;</code>：子节点的 <code>reg</code> 属性中没有长度字段（因为<code>I2C</code>设备地址不涉及地址范围）；</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code>interrupt-parent</code>：指定该设备的中断路由到哪个中断控制器。<code>&amp;liointc0</code> 是龙芯<code>2K0300</code>内部的中断控制器节点（即龙芯<code>I/O</code>中断控制器）的标签；</li>
<li><code>interrupts</code>：描述中断线的具体信息；
<ul>
<li><code>&lt;4&gt;</code>：硬件中断编号（对应<code>I2C1</code>控制器在中断控制器中的编号）；</li>
<li><code>IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_HIGH</code>：中断触发类型，这里定义为高电平触发。该宏在 <code>&lt;dt-bindings/interrupt-controller/irq.h&gt;</code> 中定义。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code>pinctrl-0</code>：指定设备使用的第一组引脚配置，<code>&amp;i2c1_pins</code> 是另一个设备树节点的标签，该节点描述了<code>I2C1</code>的<code>SCL</code>和<code>SDA</code>引脚应复用为<code>I2C</code>功能，并可能包含上拉等电气属性；</li>
<li><code>pinctrl-names</code>：为引脚的配置状态命名，与 <code>pinctrl-0</code> 对应。<code>"default"</code> 是默认状态，驱动在<code>probe</code>时会自动应用 <code>pinctrl-0</code> 的配置，引脚配置设置为<code>&amp;i2c1_pins</code>；</li>
<li><code>clock-frequency</code>：<code>I2C</code>控制器的输入时钟频率（单位<code>Hz</code>）；</li>
<li><code>status</code>：设备状态，此时处于禁用状态。</li>
</ul>
<p>更多有关设备树相关的内容可以参考：《<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/17266960.html" target="_blank"><code>linux</code>设备树-基础介绍</a>》。</p>
<h5 id="132-mpu605068">1.3.2 <code>mpu6050@68</code></h5>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/build-2k0300/workspace/linux-6.12$ vim arch/loongarch/boot/dts/ls2k300_99pi.dtsi
</code></pre>
<p>修改<code>arch/loongarch/boot/dts/ls2k300_99pi.dtsi</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-makefile">// 在根节点或合适位置（通常是 &amp;soc 内）引用并启用 I2C1
&amp;i2c1 {
    status = "okay";

	......
	
    // MPU6050 传感器
    mpu6050@68 {
        compatible = "invensense,mpu6050";
        reg = &lt;0x68&gt;;
        status = "okay";
    };
};
</code></pre>
<p>通过 <code>&amp;i2c1</code> 引用这个节点，将 <code>status</code> 改为 <code>"okay"</code>，同时添加了<code>I2C</code>从设备节点。</p>
<p>其中<code>mpu6050@68</code>设备节点下的<code>compatible</code>名称要和<code>inv_mpu_i2c.c</code>驱动中的<code>inv_mpu_driver.driver.of_match_table</code>里的名称匹配。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">/*
 * device id table is used to identify what device can be
 * supported by this driver
 */
static const struct i2c_device_id inv_mpu_id[] = {
	{"mpu6050", INV_MPU6050},
	{"mpu6500", INV_MPU6500},
	{"mpu6515", INV_MPU6515},
	{"mpu6880", INV_MPU6880},
	{"mpu9150", INV_MPU9150},
	{"mpu9250", INV_MPU9250},
	{"mpu9255", INV_MPU9255},
	{"icm20608", INV_ICM20608},
	{"icm20608d", INV_ICM20608D},
	{"icm20609", INV_ICM20609},
	{"icm20689", INV_ICM20689},
	{"icm20600", INV_ICM20600},
	{"icm20602", INV_ICM20602},
	{"icm20690", INV_ICM20690},
	{"iam20680", INV_IAM20680},
	{}
};

MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(i2c, inv_mpu_id);

static const struct of_device_id inv_of_match[] = {
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu6050",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU6050
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu6500",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU6500
	},
	{
		.compatible = "invensense,mpu6515",
		.data = (void *)INV_MPU6515
	},
    ......
}

MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(of, inv_of_match);

static const struct acpi_device_id inv_acpi_match[] = {
	{"INVN6500", INV_MPU6500},
	{ },
};
MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(acpi, inv_acpi_match);

static struct i2c_driver inv_mpu_driver = {
	.probe		=	inv_mpu_probe,
	.remove		=	inv_mpu_remove,
	.id_table	=	inv_mpu_id,
	.driver = {
		.of_match_table = inv_of_match,
		.acpi_match_table = inv_acpi_match,
		.name	=	"inv-mpu6050-i2c",
		.pm     =       pm_ptr(&amp;inv_mpu_pmops),
	},
};
</code></pre>
<p>这样在适配器注册的时候会遍历<code>i2c</code>设备树节点下的所有子设备节点，从而实现注册该控制器下的所有<code>I2C</code>从设备，具体可以参考《<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zyly/p/17131339.html#_label3_1" target="_blank"><code>I2C</code>适配器注册</a>》源码部分。</p>
<h5 id="133-i2c1_pins">1.3.3 <code>i2c1_pins</code></h5>
<p><code>i2c1_pins</code>定义在<code>arch/loongarch/boot/dts/loongson-2k0300.dtsi</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-makefile">pinmux: pinmux@16000490 {
	......
	i2c1_pins: pinmux_G50_G51_as_i2c1 {
    	    pinctrl-single,bits = &lt;0xc 0x000000f0 0x000000f0&gt;;
	};
	......
}
</code></pre>
<p>这个设备树节点是使用<code>pinctrl-single</code>驱动来配置引脚复用功能的典型写法，这行代码会在寄存器<code>0x1600049c</code>的<code>7:4</code>位写入 <code>0xf</code>，而其他位保持不变，用于将芯片的<code>GPIO50</code>和<code>GPIO51</code>这两个引脚设置为<code>I2C1</code>功能。</p>
<img src="https://gitee.com/zyly2033/blog-pic/raw/master/20260324181715115.png">
<p>注：<code>pinctrl-single</code> 是一个通用的引脚控制驱动，适用于那些引脚复用寄存器是“单寄存器位域”的芯片。当<code>SoC</code>没有提供复杂的<code>pinctrl</code>框架时，可以直接用这种方式“裸写”寄存器。</p>
<h3 id="二应用程序">二、应用程序</h3>
<p>接下来我们在<code>example</code>目录下创建子目录<code>mpu6050_app</code>；</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:~$ cd /opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example
zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example$ mkdir mpu6050_app
</code></pre>
<p>目录结构如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">zhengyang@ubuntu:/opt/2k0300/loongson_2k300_lib/example/mpu6050_app$ tree .
.
├── main.c
└── Makefile
</code></pre>
<h4 id="21-mainc">2.1 <code>main.c</code></h4>
<p>内核自带驱动把<code>MPU6050</code>注册成<code>IIO</code>传感器，应用层直接读文件即可获取距离。下面编写一个简单的测试应用程序，用于读取数据并打印；</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
#include &lt;stdlib.h&gt;
#include &lt;fcntl.h&gt;
#include &lt;unistd.h&gt;
#include &lt;string.h&gt;
#include &lt;math.h&gt;
#include &lt;time.h&gt;
#include &lt;sys/time.h&gt;

// 根据你的实际设备路径修改，通常是 iio:device0 或 iio:device1
#define IIO_DEVICE_PATH "/sys/bus/iio/devices/iio:device1"

// 灵敏度配置 (MPU6050 默认配置)
#define ACC_SENSITIVITY 16384.0f
#define GYRO_SENSITIVITY 16.4f
#define GRAVITY 9.8f
#define PI 3.1415926f

// 互补滤波系数
#define ALPHA 0.98f 

// --- 全局变量 ---
float gyro_zero_offset_x = 0.0f;
float gyro_zero_offset_y = 0.0f;
float gyro_zero_offset_z = 0.0f;

// 姿态角 (弧度)
float pitch = 0.0f; // 俯仰角
float roll = 0.0f;  // 横滚角

// --- 辅助函数：读取 sysfs 文件 ---
int read_sysfs_int(const char *path) 
{
    int fd;
    char buf[32];
    int val;
    
    // 拼接完整路径
    char full_path[256];
    snprintf(full_path, sizeof(full_path), "%s/%s", IIO_DEVICE_PATH, path);

    fd = open(full_path, O_RDONLY);
    if (fd &lt; 0) return 0; // 读取失败返回0

    memset(buf, 0, sizeof(buf));
    read(fd, buf, sizeof(buf) - 1);
    close(fd);

    val = atoi(buf);
    return val;
}

// --- 辅助函数：获取时间差 (秒) ---
double get_time_diff(struct timeval *last, struct timeval *now) 
{
    return (now-&gt;tv_sec - last-&gt;tv_sec) + (now-&gt;tv_usec - last-&gt;tv_usec) / 1000000.0;
}

// --- 1. 校准陀螺仪 ---
void calibrate_gyro() 
{
    printf("正在校准陀螺仪，请保持开发板绝对静止...\n");
    int samples = 500; // 采样次数
    long sum_x = 0, sum_y = 0, sum_z = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i &lt; samples; i++) {
        sum_x += read_sysfs_int("in_anglvel_x_raw");
        sum_y += read_sysfs_int("in_anglvel_y_raw");
        sum_z += read_sysfs_int("in_anglvel_z_raw");
        usleep(2000); // 2ms 间隔
    }

    // 计算平均值作为零偏 (转换为 rad/s)
    gyro_zero_offset_x = (sum_x / (float)samples) / GYRO_SENSITIVITY * (PI / 180.0f);
    gyro_zero_offset_y = (sum_y / (float)samples) / GYRO_SENSITIVITY * (PI / 180.0f);
    gyro_zero_offset_z = (sum_z / (float)samples) / GYRO_SENSITIVITY * (PI / 180.0f);

    printf("校准完成！零偏: X=%.4f, Y=%.4f, Z=%.4f (rad/s)\n", 
           gyro_zero_offset_x, gyro_zero_offset_y, gyro_zero_offset_z);
}

// --- 主函数 ---
int main() 
{
    struct timeval last_time, current_time;
    double dt;
    
    // 1. 初始化时间
    gettimeofday(&amp;last_time, NULL);

    // 2. 执行校准
    calibrate_gyro();

    printf("开始输出姿态数据 (Pitch: 前后倾, Roll: 左右倾)\n");
    printf("单位: 度 (°)\n");

    while (1) {
        // --- A. 读取原始数据 ---
        int acc_x_raw = read_sysfs_int("in_accel_x_raw");
        int acc_y_raw = read_sysfs_int("in_accel_y_raw");
        int acc_z_raw = read_sysfs_int("in_accel_z_raw");

        int gyro_x_raw = read_sysfs_int("in_anglvel_x_raw");
        int gyro_y_raw = read_sysfs_int("in_anglvel_y_raw");
        int gyro_z_raw = read_sysfs_int("in_anglvel_z_raw");

        // --- B. 单位转换 ---
        // 加速度转 m/s^2
        float acc_x = (acc_x_raw / ACC_SENSITIVITY) * GRAVITY;
        float acc_y = (acc_y_raw / ACC_SENSITIVITY) * GRAVITY;
        float acc_z = (acc_z_raw / ACC_SENSITIVITY) * GRAVITY;

        // 角速度转 rad/s 并减去零偏
        float gyro_x = (gyro_x_raw / GYRO_SENSITIVITY) * (PI / 180.0f) - gyro_zero_offset_x;
        float gyro_y = (gyro_y_raw / GYRO_SENSITIVITY) * (PI / 180.0f) - gyro_zero_offset_y;
        float gyro_z = (gyro_z_raw / GYRO_SENSITIVITY) * (PI / 180.0f) - gyro_zero_offset_z;

        // --- C. 计算时间间隔 dt ---
        gettimeofday(&amp;current_time, NULL);
        dt = get_time_diff(&amp;last_time, &amp;current_time);
        last_time = current_time;

        // 防止 dt 过大导致积分发散（比如调试暂停过）
        if (dt &gt; 0.1) dt = 0.01; 

        // --- D. 姿态解算 ---
        
        // 1. 加速度计计算角度 (参考角度)
        // Pitch (绕Y轴旋转)
        float acc_pitch = atan2(acc_x, sqrt(acc_y*acc_y + acc_z*acc_z)) * (180.0f / PI);
        // Roll (绕X轴旋转)
        float acc_roll = atan2(acc_y, sqrt(acc_x*acc_x + acc_z*acc_z)) * (180.0f / PI);

        // 2. 陀螺仪积分 (变化量)
        // 注意：这里简化了坐标系转换，仅适用于小角度或特定安装方向
        float gyro_pitch = gyro_y * (180.0f / PI) * dt; 
        float gyro_roll = gyro_x * (180.0f / PI) * dt;

        // 3. 互补滤波融合
        // 新角度 = 0.98 * (旧角度 + 陀螺仪变化) + 0.02 * 加速度计角度
        pitch = ALPHA * (pitch + gyro_pitch) + (1.0f - ALPHA) * acc_pitch;
        roll  = ALPHA * (roll + gyro_roll)  + (1.0f - ALPHA) * acc_roll;

        // --- E. 打印结果 ---
        // \r 用于覆盖当前行，实现刷新效果
        printf("\rPitch: %6.2f° | Roll: %6.2f° | AccZ: %.2f m/s^2", pitch, roll, acc_z);
        fflush(stdout);

        usleep(10000); // 10ms 刷新率 (100Hz)
    }

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-makefile">2.2 <code>Makefile</code></h4>
<pre><code class="language-makefile">all:
	loongarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -o main main.c -lm
clean:
	rm -rf *.o main
</code></pre>
